formulas.ascii: Per iteration, two globally synchronized passes. Force pass: F = -GRAVITY*p + REPULSION*sum over all other vertices (p-q)/max(|p-q|^2, MINIMUM_DISTANCE_SQUARED) + ATTRACTION*sum over CSR neighbors (q-p) (plus reverse CSR for directed graphs); velocity = (velocity + F*TIME_STEP)*DAMPING, capped to MAX_VELOCITY. Integration pass: position += velocity*TIME_STEP. Pinned vertices keep their positions; adjacency overflow clears velocities. Edge weights are ignored.
